old_problem: The historical review correctly prohibited the source's empty App request but treated the setter and data model as vendor-unknown. IPMI 2.0 section 28.7 standardizes Chassis NetFn 00h/Cmd 05h, its five required bytes, optional bridge byte, non-volatile behavior and Chassis 00h/Cmd 00h readback. What remains Project-specific is not command semantics: it is whether this optional facility is implemented/configurable on the exact chassis, which fields are writable, the truthful topology-backed alternate vector and recovery path.
disposition_reason: Correct the review-layer command to standard Chassis 00h/05h with capability flags, FRU, SDR, SEL and System Management addresses plus the optional Bridge address when applicable. Baseline and verify every field with Get Chassis Capabilities 00h/00h because the setter can return success while ignoring a read-only parameter. Exercise only an owner-approved, topology-valid, documented writable field one at a time; validate the affected management function at the advertised primary-IPMB address; then restore and verify the complete baseline. A no-op write is evidence of command transport only, not a functional setter PASS. A fixed/non-configurable implementation can be N/A only from authoritative platform/OEM evidence. Never send the source App request, guess an address/capability, clear logs, run the cold-reset script, retry automatically or proceed after an incomplete restore.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1055-1058, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code is unique. Related OOB row 1183 / Wistron-BMC-00473-V003 / variant 44224e41f2c06894 was directly read and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 66 was independently verified as row 1058 / variant 80dacee7c609eced.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Set Chassis Capabilities to Chassis NetFn 00h, command 05h. The source uses App NetFn 06h and supplies none of the required data, so it cannot represent the stated operation.

Section 28.7/Table 28-8 defines request byte 1 as flags with reserved bits 7:2 zero, bit1 Front Panel Lockout and bit0 intrusion; bytes 2-5 are the Chassis FRU, SDR, SEL and System Management device addresses; byte 6 is the optional Chassis Bridge address.

Section 28.1/Table 28-2 defines Get Chassis Capabilities Chassis 00h/00h and states these non-volatile values describe functions on the primary IPMB. Address fields use the 7-bit I2C address in bits7:1 with bit0 zero; 00h means unspecified. Get also reports Power Interlock and Diagnostic Interrupt flags that the standard setter does not expose for change.

The standard does not require the capability record to be configurable and permits it to be hardcoded. Therefore setter support and writability must be established for the exact chassis/firmware; unsupported/N/A requires platform authority rather than inference from an unchanged response.

Table 28-8 explicitly says an attempted read-only change need not return an error. Completion 00h alone cannot pass; the complete Get response must be compared field by field with the approved expectation after both the write and restore.

Capability flags must truthfully describe physical behavior, and routing addresses must identify the actual FRU/SDR/SEL/SM/Bridge providers on the primary IPMB. A safe alternate vector therefore depends on an approved Project topology and per-field writable matrix, but that finite runtime configuration does not keep the engineering decision pending.
The unrelated cold-reset script and source log clearing add actions not required by the standard and are excluded. This case changes a persistent capability record, not BMC reset behavior.

ED-03 separates standardized BMC semantics from OEM inputs; ED-13 and ED-15 require authority for unsupported/N/A; ED-17 preserves evidence; ED-19 keeps the IB identity distinct from OOB; ED-28 and ED-30 require isolated recovery; ED-33 through ED-38 govern versioned packages, confirmation, cleanup, no retry and engineer verdict ownership.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Set Chassis Capabilities (IB Chassis 00h/05h) topology-valid field update, readback and restore
test_case.purpose: Prove on the in-band system interface that each Project-approved configurable chassis-capability field can be written with the standard complete vector, truthfully read back and functionally validated without changing reserved/read-only fields, then restore the exact non-volatile baseline while preserving the separate OOB coverage identity.
required_package: Approved chassis/BMC/firmware identity, local IPMI system interface and independent OOB/physical recovery path; authoritative platform statement that Chassis 00h/05h is implemented and which fields are writable or fixed
Raw and decoded Chassis 00h/00h baseline containing flags, FRU/SDR/SEL/SM addresses and optional Bridge address; primary-IPMB topology proving every nonzero address and actual capability

Owner-approved per-field matrix with baseline, one truthful alternate value, expected post-write value, affected-function read-only probe, service impact, restore vector and N/A evidence for fixed fields

Versioned ipmitool/raw runner restricted to in-band `-I open`, Chassis 00h/05h with exactly five or approved six bytes, reserved/LSB validation, 00h/00h parser, exact full-vector restore and zero automatic retries

Immediate confirmation before every non-volatile write, preserved SEL/system/audit logs, timestamped command/readback/function evidence and an authorized engineer to issue per-field and overall verdicts
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED PARAMETERIZED PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Preserve logs and do not run the linked cold-reset script. From the local system interface read Chassis 00h/00h once; record the complete BASE vector and whether Bridge byte 7 is returned. Validate reserved Get flag bits, even IPMB address encoding, actual primary-IPMB topology, platform setter support and the approved writable-field matrix. For each documented writable field independently, build CANDIDATE by changing only that field to its truthful approved alternate while keeping request flag bits7:2 zero, preserving BASE flag bits1:0 and all other required addresses, and including the Bridge byte only when the implementation contract requires it. Display the exact five/six-byte candidate, topology effect and restore vector for immediate approval; send Chassis 00h/05h [CANDIDATE] exactly once with `-I open`; require completion 00h but do not treat it as PASS. Read 00h/00h and require every field to equal the per-field expected vector, including unchanged read-only Power Interlock/Diagnostic Interrupt flags; run only the approved read-only reachability/identity check for the affected FRU, SDR, SEL, SM or Bridge function. Send 00h/05h [BASE_SETTABLE_VECTOR] exactly once, read 00h/00h and require the entire baseline plus affected-function reachability to be restored. A documented fixed field is not written; an implementation with no safely configurable field is N/A only from authoritative platform evidence. Never send source 06h/05h, omit mandatory bytes, invent a capability/address, perform a no-op and claim setter coverage, clear logs, reset/power-cycle, retry or continue after a mismatch.
test_case.expected_result: The correct standard request returns completion 00h for each authorized field. Get Chassis Capabilities reports the exact approved post-write vector: only the intended writable field differs, reserved and non-target fields remain valid, Get-only Power Interlock/Diagnostic flags do not change, and the affected management function remains reachable at the advertised topology-valid address or exhibits the specifically approved capability behavior. The single restore returns 00h, the complete Get record equals BASE and affected function reachability is restored. Unsupported command, silent retention of a field expected writable, unexpected field mutation, false capability advertisement, broken routing, missing optional-byte contract or failed restore is FAIL/NOT READY without retry. Fixed/non-configurable N/A requires platform evidence; completion success or a no-op alone cannot pass.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant, Chassis 00h/05h identity, a complete five/six-byte validated vector, documented setter support/writability, one field at a time, completion plus full 00h/00h equality, functional topology evidence and exact baseline restoration. App 06h/05h, missing bytes, reserved/odd/unknown address bits, command success alone, guessed alternate values, no-op-only testing, cold reset, cleared logs, automatic retry, OOB evidence substituted for this IB identity or incomplete restore cannot pass. A field without an approved safe alternate remains NOT READY; N/A is allowed only when authoritative design/firmware evidence proves the standard optional setter or field is fixed/unsupported.
safety_gate: Use only the local system interface for this IB identity and keep an independent OOB/physical recovery path available. Row 1183 OOB evidence cannot satisfy this case.

Verify exact chassis/BMC/firmware, Get baseline and physical/logical primary-IPMB topology before writing. Do not change a flag unless it remains truthful or an address unless that provider actually exists and is reachable there.

Send the complete vector and alter only one documented writable field. Request flags bits7:2 and every address bit0 are zero; 00h is used only when the approved topology defines the field as unspecified.
Treat completion 00h as transport evidence only because read-only changes may be ignored without error. Stop immediately on any readback or functional mismatch.
Preserve logs and management access. Do not use the unrelated cold-reset script, reset, power cycle, clear SEL, change multiple routing fields or use a state-changing functional probe.
No automatic retry. On ambiguity, perform read-only Get/reachability checks, issue the precomputed exact baseline restore at most once when safe, then hand recovery to the platform owner.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant, chassis/BMC/firmware/system-interface identity, official standard-command authority and distinct row-1183 OOB Source Key/variant
Raw/decoded 00h/00h baseline; authoritative setter support and per-field writability; primary-IPMB topology and even-address validation; approved per-field candidate/expected/restore matrix
Runner/version/hash, immediate approvals and each redacted five/six-byte 00h/05h request, completion and complete field-by-field Get comparison
Affected FRU/SDR/SEL/SM/Bridge read-only identity/reachability evidence or capability-specific evidence proving the advertised record remains truthful
Exact restore request, complete baseline equality, restored function reachability, preserved OOB/system/log health and any fixed/unsupported platform evidence
Per-field PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A table and engineer verdict, explicitly stating that the review agent executed no DUT command
test_case.recovery: Before each field, precompute the exact standard setter vector corresponding to BASE flags bits1:0 and BASE addresses, including the optional Bridge field exactly as required by the implementation. If completion or readback is ambiguous, make no second candidate attempt; preserve evidence, query 00h/00h and affected function read-only through the independent path, then send that baseline vector once only when the owner-approved recovery contract says it remains safe. If restore or management-function reachability fails, stop the matrix and let the platform owner use the documented independent recovery. Do not cold-reset, power-cycle, clear logs or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the title-command conflict: the review layer corrects empty App 06h/05h to Chassis 00h/05h with the complete standardized vector, excludes the cold-reset script and replaces success-only Criteria with full Get/read-function/restore evidence.

blocked.reason: Core command, request schema, readback behavior and restore shape are standardized. Exact setter support, writable fields, truthful alternate vector and topology are bounded Project execution prerequisites rather than an unresolved engineering command decision.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 28.1 and 28.7/Tables 28-2 and 28-8 plus Appendix G define Chassis 00h/Cmd05h, five required and one optional request fields, non-volatile Get 00h readback, IPMB address format, optional/configurability limits and the requirement to read back fields because read-only change attempts need not return an error.

project_authority: Chassis/BMC owners must prove that this optional setter is implemented on the exact firmware, publish the writable-field and primary-IPMB topology map, approve only truthful per-field alternate vectors and read-only function probes, and own recovery/verdicts. They may mark fixed/non-configurable behavior N/A only from authoritative platform evidence. They cannot approve guessed addresses/capabilities, the source App request, completion-only or no-op-only PASS, loss of management reachability, reset/power recovery, log clearing, automatic retry or substitution of the separate OOB variant.
